# Vulnerabilities that `make vulncheck` reports without failing
# (scripts/govulncheck_gate.py). One entry per line: <OSV ID> <justification>.
# Remove an entry as soon as a fixed release can be adopted; the gate prints a
# notice when an entry is no longer reported.

GO-2026-6278 gorilla/websocket v1.5.3 picks client frame mask keys with a weak PRNG. The mask carries no confidentiality (the key is sent in the frame); it only protects WebSocket-unaware intercepting proxies from cache poisoning by attacker-chosen client payloads. Only Tenderdash's WebSocket client (rpc/jsonrpc/client) masks; the node's WebSocket server does not. The fix exists only as an untagged master pseudo-version (v1.5.4-0.20240701034025-d67f41855da4). Revisit when gorilla/websocket tags a fixed release.
